name: site_pages
title: Site Pages
description: One published page of a website: its site name and page slug make its address (/s/{site}/{slug}; slug index is /s/{site}), html is the whole page as its builder exported it. The author's HTML is never trusted by the server: it is served sandboxed by site_sites_page.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: Page
fields.help: the page's address in the site; index is the home page

fields.name: is_public
fields.label: Public
fields.help: anyone can see it; otherwise only you
